caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be an old, worn leather bag or pouch mounted onto a rough, rectangular wooden board. The leather component is a dark brown, with lighter brown areas where the material has been worn or creased. The bag is attached to the board by a series of round metal studs or rivets, evenly spaced along the edge of the leather where it meets the wood. The handle or strap of the bag is made of the same dark brown leather and is attached to the upper left side, curving upward. The wooden board has a light brown to tan coloration with visible grain and knife marks, and its edges are slightly irregular, indicating wear or manual shaping. The entire composition is rendered in muted, earthy tones, and is placed centrally on a plain, cream-colored background.
title: Swamp Shoe for Horse
